title: Aoyagi Toya — Respect For My Teammates〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: STAY GOLDEN went better than I could've ever expected today.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, so well that I still don't know what to say about it...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We were right next to her and I think she surprised us the most out of everybody that was there.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But you kinda had a moment like that at another event we did, Toya...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: At the same time, why do I get the feeling that you saw this coming?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You were the one that kept talking about how we should go back to STAY GOLDEN and show Kohane that there was more to this than just chasing after us...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Still, how Azusawa ended up performing went well beyond my expectations.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And ultimately, it was a good surprise.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: People are able to move forward by seeing others do the same, and it creates a sort of cycle...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: She's both our teammate and rival. I feel like this setup suits us well.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Man, another person I have to compete against...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That may be so, but this is also what it means to be a team and it's very fun.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Nothing... It's just weird to hear you say that something is fun, you know?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I wasn't trying to say anything strange...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
What are you talking about, dude?
Don't you remember what happened that one time?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What do your true feelings tell you right now? Do you really not want to do this with me anymore?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You have no idea how many times I've thought about just focusing on chasing your dream with you!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Do you understand just how hard it was to get you to say how you actually felt?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: At least we're doing a lot better than we were back then.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Right. We've found a way to move forward.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: All so that we can surpass that legendary night.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah. It definitely looked like it. You couldn't tell what you were doing?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It did feel good, sort of...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (That reminds me of when Len and I were talking...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
You must feel it, Toya.
The happy anticipation!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Why? I think it's great that you got so excited that you went a little nuts!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (This is the same feeling I had when I was talking to Len... Happy anticipation...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Normally, I'd suggest going to the park to practice some more...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
But it's getting pretty late.
We should head home soon.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, and we'll be back first thing in the morning anyway. It can wait until then.
